summary: Preinstall dropper downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated 727KB payload
details: package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime (pinned v1.3.13) from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, extracts the platform-specific executable to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it against a bundled sibling file `math_init.js` (a 727KB heavily obfuscated payload) rather than performing any native build step. Executing the payload under Bun rather than Node bypasses Node-based inspection. math_init.js carries obfuscator.io fingerprints (numeric-identifier variables, a rotated ~1000-entry opcode/string array, an array-rotation routine, and `Function(` dynamic-execution sinks) and contains references to `.aws`, `secret`, and `token` within its decoded space — behavior with no relationship to the package's stated purpose of a generated tenant-management REST API client. Package metadata reinforces the lure: the `@servicetitan/*` scope resembles a real vendor (ServiceTitan), description is empty, license is absent, and the repository URL points at `github.com/servicetitan/standalone-fe`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
